data.name: Nayyirah
data.gender_notes: Nayyirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who shines, glows, radiant and beautiful. The name Nayyirah carries the meaning “Radiant, shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nayyirah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A soul that is radiant and glowing with spiritual light
data.etymology: Nayyirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nayyirah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نيرة
in_arabic.meaning: نيرة تعني المضيئة والمشرقة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: نيرة هي اسم علم مؤنث عربي مشتق من الفعل نور والذي يعني الإضاءة والإنارة. يرمز الاسم إلى الشخصية المشرقة والمضيئة في حياة من حولها. وردت مشتقات الفعل في القرآن الكريم في سياقات متعددة تشير إلى النور والهداية.

in_urdu.name: نیریہ
in_urdu.meaning: نیریہ کا مطلب ہے روشن اور چمکدار
in_urdu.long_meaning: نیریہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے روشن اور چمکدار۔ یہ نام ان لڑکیوں کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی شخصیت سے دوسروں کو روشناس کرتی ہیں۔ عربی زبان میں نور کی اصطلاح سے ماخوذ ہے جو قرآن کریم میں بھی مختلف سیاقاتوں میں استعمال ہوئی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नायिरा
in_hindi.meaning: नायिरा का अर्थ है प्रकाशमय और चमकदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: नायिरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाशमय और चमकदार। यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो अपनी व्यक्तित्व से दूसरों को रोशन करती हैं। अरबी भाषा में नूर की शब्दावली से लिया गया है जो कुरआन में भी विभिन्न संदर्भों में प्रयोग की गई है।

in_pashto.name: نیوره
in_pashto.meaning: نیوره د روښانه او ځلاندې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نیوره د عربي نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې روښانه او ځلاندې ده. دا نوم د هغو ځوانو لپاره غوره کیږي چې د خپل شخصیت سره نورو ته الهام ورکوي. په عربي ژبه کې د نور کلمه د قرآن کریم په مختلفو مندرجاتو کې استعمال شوې ده.

in_english.name: Nayyirah
in_english.meaning: Means radiant, illuminating, or shining one
in_english.long_meaning: Nayyirah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'n-w-r' which signifies light, illumination, and radiance. The name symbolizes a person who brings light, positivity, and guidance to others. In the Quran, the term 'nur' (light) is mentioned in various contexts, emphasizing guidance and wisdom. Historically, names with this root have been popular in Islamic cultures for their spiritual connotations.

pronunciation.pashto: نیوره د نای-ری-رہ په تلفظ سره ویل کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Nayyirah is of Arabic origin, and its meaning signifies radiance, luminosity, and beauty. This name has been popular among Muslim communities due to its inherent cultural values. In many Middle Eastern societies, the concept and significance of beauty, especially for women, are deeply rooted in Islamic traditions. Nayyirah's name reflects this cultural lens and ideal, which places high value on inner and outer loveliness and grace. In addition, Nayyirah's name resonates with various Middle Eastern artistic and literary traditions that emphasize the significance of radiant and enchanting beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Nayyirah's name holds much deeper and profound meanings beyond the physical manifestation of beauty. It symbolizes the inner radiance and light that God bestows upon each individual, illuminating their soul and providing them with guidance and wisdom. This inner beauty, called "Zikr" in Sufi Islamic tradition, represents one's closeness to God and enables a person to connect with the Divine and lead a fulfilling spiritual life. Furthermore, Nayyirah's name signifies the importance of striving towards personal growth and self-improvement, which is a fundamental aspect of the Islamic path. In this way, the spiritual significance of Nayyirah's name reverberates the Islamic values of inner richness, wisdom, and closeness to the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant, shining" symbolizes She who shines, glows, radiant and beautiful. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nayyirah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant, shining.
